Coram : S.S.M. QUADRI, K.G. BALAKRISHNAN
Income Tax Act, 1961; Sections 60 and 256(2): Assessee, a partner in a firm assigned part of his share income to a Trust-Tribunal held the income so assigned to Trust would be included in the total income of the assessee for the purpose qf assessment-High Court reversing the same-On appeal held, assigner partner as assignee and not as a sub-partner it is a case of application of income by the assessee and not diversion qf income by. over riding title-Such share of income of assessee of the firm could be included in total income for the purpose of assessment-!ndia11 Partnership Act-Section
Decision Date : 10-12-2002 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 1899/2002 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
